purpose: Predictive Microarchitecture, Biological Feasibility & Independent Validation

phase1_keratin_hydration_audit.physical_root_cause: Single exponential E0*exp(-kw*w) assumes uniform plasticization across the entire hydration domain. In biological keratin, amorphous matrix plasticization undergoes a cooperative glass transition between w=0.08 and w=0.25 (Tg drops below 20 C). Below w=0.10, water is bound and the matrix remains glassy. Extrapolating the steep glass-transition slope back to dry conditions creates a virtual, unphysical E0 = 8.54 GPa.

overall_loso_lomo_performance.tier4_pangolin_outperformance: Tier 4 reduces error on held-out pangolin scale from 1.073 GPa to 0.297 GPa (72.3% improvement over Tier 2)

phase2_microarchitecture_transfer.scientific_verdict: Tier 4 microarchitecture transfer model demonstrates physical generalization to an entirely novel biological material (pangolin scale) without post-hoc parameters. The 0.45 factor in Cycle 7 was an ad-hoc fit; the current model physically derives scale compliance from classical laminate theory (eta_plywood = 0.52) and measured intermediate filament fraction (phi_if = 0.38).

translational_scaling_verdict.justification: While strict dynamic LOSO achieves an MAE of 6.02% across rodent and porcine models, universal translation to human clinical VML cannot be asserted. Human skeletal muscle volume (TA mass ~160 g vs rat ~0.6 g) imposes diffusion limits where central scaffold necrosis occurs beyond 5-10 mm from host vasculature. Furthermore, human axonal reinnervation distance (1 mm/day over 20+ cm) exceeds the 6-12 month critical motor endplate fibrosis window.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: Intramembranous ossification (osteoblasts) or continuous cornified plate.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Discrete follicular placodes with localized germinative centers in malpighian layer.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Dermal fibroblasts producing dense regular collagen I/III and elastin network.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: Continuous bone remodeling via osteoclasts/osteoblasts (months, high calcium flux).
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Continuous outward cornification from basal matrix; distal wear offset by proximal growth.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Slow turnover of structural collagen (half-life ~100-300 days), low baseline maintenance.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: Callus formation requires prolonged immobilization; unhealed microcracks accumulate.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Shed or fractured scales regrow from undamaged basal germinal beds (6-12 months).
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Fibrotic scar formation; high risk of chronic capsular contracture.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: Requires Haversian canal systems through cortical bone; vulnerable to compression ischemia.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Capillary supply restricted to basal dermal papillae; protruding scale is dead cornified tissue.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Requires extensive 3D capillary mesh throughout depth; high risk of hematoma.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: Periosteal nociceptors generate severe pain under blunt impact; poor shear sensing.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Mechanoreceptors (Merkel discs, Ruffini) concentrated in flexible inter-scale hinge skin.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Diffuse subcutaneous mechanoreceptors; good pressure detection.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: Mass ~10-15 kg; remodeling power ~15-25 W; mineral burden ~500 mg Ca/day.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Mass ~5-7 kg; synthesis rate ~15-30 g/day (~60-120 kcal/day or ~3-6 W); sulfur amino acid demand.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Mass ~4-6 kg; baseline metabolic maintenance ~2-4 W.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: Severe constraint on surface strain (< 2%); requires full unarmored flexion gaps.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Imbricated sliding accommodates 40-60% effective skin strain via scissor-like tile expansion.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Accommodates up to 25-30% strain elastically, but exhibits high shear resistance.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: CRITICAL RISK: Rigid hoop stiffness prevents muscle expansion, surging pressure > 45 mmHg.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: LOW RISK: Scales slide circumferentially over fascia; circumferential hoop hoop stress is uncoupled.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: MODERATE RISK: Viscoelastic layer expands radially, minimal rigid containment.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: CRITICAL RISK: Blocks evaporative sweat loss over > 90% of covered surface.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: MODERATE RISK: Inter-scale hinges retain sweat pores and micro-channels (15-25% open area).
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: CRITICAL RISK: Massive thermal insulation (blubber effect) impedes core heat conduction.

phase5_endogenous_dimensions.monolithic_rigid_plate: High blunt force transmission; risk of catastrophic brittle cracking.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.segmented_overlapping_scales: Inter-scale friction and localized scale delamination dissipate kinetic energy progressively.
phase5_endogenous_dimensions.subdermal_fibrous_lattice: Excellent blunt impact cushioning, but poor puncture/slash resistance.
